        source = ctx.pods[ctx.graph.src[edge]]
        destination = ctx.pods[ctx.graph.dst[edge]]

        outgoing: bool = False
        exact: bool = False
        if source.id == pod.id and destination.id != pod.id:
            peer = destination.current_node
            outgoing = True
            exact = True
        elif destination.id == pod.id and source.id != pod.id:
            peer = source.current_node
            exact = True

            outgoing = True
        elif destination.service == pod.service and destination.app == pod.app and source.app == pod.app and source.service != pod.service:

                latency = 0.0

                outgoing_worst = max(outgoing_worst, latency)

            elif exact:
                incoming_total = incoming_total + latency
                incoming_worst = max(incoming_worst, latency)
                incoming_count = incoming_count + 1
            elif outgoing:
                fallback_out_total = fallback_out_total + latency
                fallback_out_worst = max(fallback_out_worst, latency)
                fallback_out_count = fallback_out_count + 1

    if cpu_after > node.cpu_capacity or mem_after > node.mem_capacity:

    mem_util = float(mem_after) / float(node.mem_capacity)

    mem_share = float(pod.mem_request) / float(node.mem_capacity)

    pressure = pressure + 800.0 * mem_tail * mem_tail / mem_slack

    headroom = max(1.0 - peak, 0.01)
    reserve_deficit = max(peak - 0.50, 0.0)

    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))

    worst_path = 0.0

        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]

        elif destination == pod.id:

                latency = neighbor_node.latency_to_ms[node.id]
                if outgoing:
                    latency = node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]

                neighbor_cpu = float(neighbor_node.cpu_allocated) / float(max(neighbor_node.cpu_capacity, 1))
                neighbor_mem = float(neighbor_node.mem_allocated) / float(max(neighbor_node.mem_capacity, 1))
                neighbor_peak = max(neighbor_cpu, neighbor_mem)
                if neighbor.current_node == node.id:
                    neighbor_peak = peak

                dependency_pressure = pressure_of(neighbor_peak)
                endpoint_peak = max(peak, neighbor_peak)

                link_risk = link_risk * link_risk
                link_risk = link_risk / max(1.0 - endpoint_peak, 0.10)
                weighted_latency = weighted_latency + rate * latency
                weighted_tail = weighted_tail + rate * link_risk
                weighted_dependency = weighted_dependency + rate * dependency_pressure

                worst_latency = max(worst_latency, latency)
                path_risk = latency / 30.0 + link_risk
                path_risk = path_risk + 0.35 * dependency_pressure
                worst_path = max(worst_path, path_risk)

    # Directional link tails and projected endpoint pressure protect dependencies.
    path_cost = 0.0
    dependency_cost = 0.0
    if weight > 0.0:
        path_cost = weighted_latency / weight / 15.0
        path_cost = path_cost + weighted_tail / weight
        path_cost = path_cost + worst_latency / 45.0
        dependency_cost = weighted_dependency / weight

    power_cost = dynamic_power * max(cpu_after - cpu_before, 0.0)
    if node.cpu_allocated == 0 and node.mem_allocated == 0:
        power_cost = power_cost + node.power_idle_w

    cost = 2.0 * pressure + path_cost + 0.35 * dependency_cost
    cost = cost + 0.40 * worst_path + 0.25 * power_cost / 120.0
    return -cost

    pressure = pressure + 160.0 * mem_excess * mem_excess / mem_slack

    cpu_tail = max(cpu_util - 0.58, 0.0)
    mem_tail = max(mem_util - 0.82, 0.0)
    pressure = pressure + 2000.0 * cpu_tail * cpu_tail / cpu_slack
    pressure = pressure + 600.0 * mem_tail * mem_tail / mem_slack

    power_range = max(node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w, 0.0)
    incremental_power = power_range * cpu_share
    if node.suspended or (node.suspendable and node.cpu_allocated == 0 and node.mem_allocated == 0):
        incremental_power = incremental_power + max(node.power_idle_w, 0.0)
    incremental_power = max(incremental_power, 0.0)

    communication = communication_cost(pod, node, ctx)
    communication = communication * (1.0 + 0.75 * cpu_util / cpu_slack)
    energy_weight = 1.0 / (1.0 + pressure / 100.0 + communication / 200.0)
    cost = communication + pressure + 1.80 * energy_weight * incremental_power
    return -cost

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    # Without cumulative disruption counters, preserve migration allowances.

    return out

def resource_score(requested: int, capacity: int) -> int:

        return 0

    mem = resource_score(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request, node.mem_capacity)
